# Garage Gaffer

> Bristol, UK marketplace connecting drivers with vetted mobile mechanics and partner garages for vehicle repairs, diagnostics and servicing.

Garage Gaffer lets drivers in Bristol, UK enter their vehicle registration and postcode to get an instant labour price for common repairs and servicing, then book online. If the job needs spare parts, their cost is confirmed separately within a day; the labour price itself is quoted immediately. Jobs are carried out by vetted local mechanics, either at the customer's driveway or at a trusted partner garage. Garage Gaffer also recruits and vets mechanics and garages who want a steady stream of itemised jobs.

## Audiences

- Drivers in Bristol, UK looking to book vehicle repairs, diagnostics or servicing.
- Mechanics and garages in Bristol, UK looking to join the network as service providers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://garagegaffer.co.uk/): overview and instant price search.
- [Services](https://garagegaffer.co.uk/services): full list of services offered, by category.
- [How It Works](https://garagegaffer.co.uk/how-it-works): the booking process, step by step.
- [About](https://garagegaffer.co.uk/about): what Garage Gaffer is and how vetting works.
- [Become a Mechanic](https://garagegaffer.co.uk/become-a-mechanic): how mechanics and garages join the network.
- [Support](https://garagegaffer.co.uk/support): contact and help.

## Notes

- Booking (`/booking/*`) is a private, session-based checkout flow, not indexable content, and isn't listed individually here.
- Coverage is Bristol, UK only. Exact pricing and availability are provided at the time of booking, not fixed catalog prices.
- The instant price covers labour only. If a job turns out to need spare parts, their cost is confirmed separately within a day, not included in the instant quote.
